title: Daidara List

blocks.text: By selling materials at Daidara, new weapons, armor, and accessories will become available for purchase. Some of these items are needed for certain quests. Occasionally, Daidara Metalworks may be open at night. During these times Daidara will offer a 20% discount. Here is the list of what Daidara can sell and all related details.

text:
